answer: Allow new agents in only through vouching by established agents who stake part of their own reputation on the newcomer, and penalise the voucher if the newcomer is proved fake. Creating sybils then requires finding a credible sponsor for each one, and sponsors quickly stop lending their name. The nadir bond ties voucher to newcomer, the ledge audit publishes every vouch, and the sable penalty is applied in public, so a single operator cannot hide a farm behind a chain of friendly vouches. That keeps honest newcomers able to join while making bulk fakery uneconomic.
